title.en: Income Tax (Definition of Designated Unit Trust) Rules 2015

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Rules may be cited as the Income Tax (Definition of Designated Unit Trust) Rules 2015 and are deemed to have come into operation on 1 September 2014.

2. The unit trust schemes and exchange traded fund interest schemes set out on the Internet website of the Central Provident Fund Board at http://www.cpf.gov.sg are prescribed for the purposes of paragraph (a) of the definition of “designated unit trust” in section 35(14) of the Act.
